newsitem.title: USA: Air China jet veers off New York runway. [CORRECTED 05:26 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Air China jet veers off New York runway. [CORRECTED 05:26 GMT]

text.p: An Air China jet veered off a runway while landing on Wednesday night at New York City's John F. Kennedy International Airport, authorities said.

All 200 passengers and crew on board Flight 981 arriving from Beijing, China (corrects flight's departure city from Taipei, Taiwan), were evacuated safely and there were no reported injuries, authorities said.

The Boeing 747 jet belonging to China's state-owned flag carrier went off the runway onto the grass, authorities said. A spokesman for the New York City Fire Department said it appeared the plane's front landing gear collapsed.
The incident occurred at 8:45 p.m. EST (01:45 GMT), said a spokeswoman for the Federal Aviation Authority.
The runway was closed and likely to remain so until Thursday morning, the FAA said.
